parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the ListInstances operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: LabelTableIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the label tables by which to filter the results.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the label table.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `Asc`: ascending order.

- `Desc`: descending order.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the owner.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Page numbers start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The project ID. You can call the `ListProjects` operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.
